description: The chart illustrates “effect” values across multiple language-family categories for several multilingual BERT-based model variants, shown as grouped bars with error bars. The horizontal axis contains the categories IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic family, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, presented left to right in that order; the vertical axis is labeled “effect” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at approximately 0, 10, 20, and 30 (with the plotted range extending slightly below 0 and above 30). Each category contains six adjacent bars corresponding to the legend entries mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (darker blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pinkish), and XLM-B₂ (red), and each bar includes a vertical error bar with caps. Approximate bar heights by category are: IE-Baltic shows small positive effects (roughly ~1–6) across all six bars; IE-Germanic shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ near ~10, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ slightly below 0, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~15; IE-Indic shows mBERT-L₂ near ~1, XLM-L₂ near ~0, mBERT-R₂ around ~20, XLM-R₂ around ~18, mBERT-B₂ around ~24, and XLM-B₂ around ~21; IE-Romance shows mid single-digit values (about ~4–7) for L₂ and R₂ variants and around ~6–13 for B₂ variants; IE-Slavic family shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ around ~9–11, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near ~1 and slightly below 0 respectively, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~16–17; IE-other shows mBERT-L₂ and XLM-L₂ around ~6, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ near 0 to slightly below 0, and mBERT-B₂ and XLM-B₂ around ~8; Isolate shows all bars clustered close to 0 (roughly ~0–2); Semitic shows mBERT-L₂ around ~11, XLM-L₂ around ~16, mBERT-R₂ and XLM-R₂ slightly below 0, mBERT-B₂ around ~15, and XLM-B₂ around ~19; Uralic shows all bars near ~0–2. The bars are not visually sorted by height within categories, and no individual bars appear specially emphasized beyond the consistent color coding and the presence of error bars.
